title: Blood Donation Depends on 3% of Eligible People
hook: Most eligible donors never join the pool hospitals rely on.
closing: A shrinking donor base leaves hospitals depending on the same small group.
question: Would you donate blood?

segments.say: Only 3 percent of eligible people donate blood. Hospitals depend on a very small volunteer pool.
US blood donor volume fell to an index of 60. Fewer people are replacing the regular donors who age out.
